title: Quasi-SVD: Learning a Lie-constrained matrix factorisation for real-time imaging
abstract: arXiv:2607.25967v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) underlies matrix factorisation tasks across many fields, with imaging applications demanding real-time processing. Yet SVD algorithms are inherently sequential, constraining real-time GPU throughput and limit online deployment in imaging pipelines. This study introduces a fully parallelized matrix factorization framework for GPUs by enforcing matrix orthogonality on left singular vectors via Lie-parametrised algebra and recovering the remaining components through soft constraints. This asymmetric constraint design enables an efficient parallel and provably valid decomposition, achieves high reconstruction fidelity and substantially accelerates computation relative to the exact SVD, with real-time throughput exceeding standard video frame rates. translated_title: 准SVD：学习李群约束的矩阵分解以实现实时成像
translated_abstract: 奇异值分解（SVD）是众多领域中矩阵分解任务的基础，其中成像应用对实时处理有很高要求。然而，SVD算法本质上是顺序执行的，这限制了GPU的实时吞吐量，并阻碍了其在成像流水线中的在线部署。本研究通过李参数化代数对左奇异向量施加矩阵正交性约束，并通过软约束恢复其余分量，从而提出了一种面向GPU的完全并行化矩阵分解框架。这种非对称约束设计实现了高效的并行且可证明有效的分解，在达到高重建保真度的同时，计算速度相对于精确SVD大幅提升，其实时吞吐量超过了标准视频帧率。该方法的性能在多个跨越不同计算模式的成像任务上进行了评估：(1) 用于超声成像的时空背景减除……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究提出“准SVD”框架，利用李群参数化对左奇异向量施加正交约束并以软约束恢复其余分量，实现了GPU上完全并行、可证明有效的矩阵分解，在保持高重建保真度的同时大幅超越精确SVD的速度，达到超过标准视频帧率的实时吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This study introduces "Quasi-SVD", a fully parallelized matrix factorization framework that enforces orthogonality on left singular vectors via Lie-parametrised algebra and recovers remaining components through soft constraints, achieving provably valid decomposition on GPUs with high reconstruction fidelity and real-time throughput exceeding standard video frame rates.
